review.summary: The change adds an optional, validated `DISCORD_MENTION_ID` and appends a `<@id>` mention on its own final line, reserving space so the mention survives the 1800-character truncation while leaving the no-mention path unchanged. Validation and tests cover every listed abuse case (mentions, short/long/non-ASCII ids, newline and `>` injection), docs/config/CHANGELOG are updated, and the implementation is small and consistent with the class. No blocking or notable issues were found.
